anchor: Owner , at its sole cost
Any amount not paid when due under this Article 4
segments: If Owner 2 fails to perform any Maintenance Work required under this Article 4 within thirty (30) days after written notice from Owner 1 (or, in the case of snow and ice removal or any condition presenting an imminent risk of injury to persons or damage to property, within twenty-four (24) hours after notice, which may be given by telephone or email), Owner 1 may perform such Maintenance Work, and Owner 2 shall reimburse Owner 1 for seventy percent (70%) of the reasonable, actual, out-of-pocket cost thereof within thirty (30) days after receipt of an invoice. Owner 1 may offset any amount not so reimbursed against amounts otherwise payable by Owner 1 under this Article 4.

anchor: Waiver of Subrogation.
segments: Each Owner shall maintain commercial general liability insurance covering its Property, including the Shared Facilities located thereon, and its and its Permittees' use of the Shared Facilities, with limits of not less than One Million Dollars ($1,000,000.00) per occurrence and Two Million Dollars ($2,000,000.00) in the aggregate, naming the other Owner as an additional insured, and shall deliver a certificate evidencing such insurance to the other Owner upon request. Owner 2 shall require each contractor performing Maintenance Work to maintain commercial general liability insurance with like limits naming both Owners as additional insureds.

anchor: supersedes all prior understandings regarding the same.
text: Notwithstanding the foregoing, nothing in this Agreement terminates, modifies, or limits the Agreement Creating Reciprocal Easements recorded November 22, 1989 in Miscellaneous Volume 56, Page 685, Clermont County, Ohio Records, or any recorded sanitary sewer or utility easement benefiting either Property, each of which remains in full force and effect.

anchor: Counterparts.
segments: Concurrently with the execution of this Agreement, Owner 2 shall cause the holder of each mortgage encumbering the Owner 2 Property to execute and deliver, for recording with this Agreement, a consent and subordination by which such holder consents to this Agreement and subordinates the lien of its mortgage to the easements and rights granted in this Agreement.

anchor: Counterparts.
segments: All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be delivered by hand, by nationally recognized overnight courier, or by certified mail, return receipt requested, to an Owner at the address to which real estate tax bills for such Owner's Property are mailed by the Clermont County Treasurer, or at such other address as such Owner designates by notice to the other Owner, with a copy by email to any email address so designated. Notice shall be effective upon delivery or refusal of delivery.
